mentions.name: perlc
mentions.description: This compiler for Perl 5.42.x generates static code, enabling Perl programs to be deployed without exporting the entire environment or building a container. It currently works well.
mentions.problem: Deploying Perl code currently requires either exporting the entire environment or building a container; the latter is not possible in a number of deployment cases, and the former carries dependency radius gotchas.
mentions.author: hpcjoe
